name: The AI Assistant for the WPadmin
author: wpspin

sections.description:
WPadmin.AI adds AI directly to the WordPress admin experience.

This plugin currently covers two layers of service:

  • V1 inside this plugin for site-aware answers, troubleshooting, plugin recommendations, code snippets, and Premium data-aware insights.
  • Premium V2 for a deeper managed technical workspace that becomes available only after manual onboarding, provisioning, and readiness checks.

That means site owners can start with everyday WordPress help and grow into a more advanced Premium workflow when they need deeper technical execution.

Learn more about the platform at wpadmin.ai.

Free and Premium

Free includes:

  • AI chatbox inside wp-admin
  • site-aware WordPress guidance
  • plugin recommendations
  • step-by-step troubleshooting
  • 30 monthly questions

Premium includes everything in Free, plus:

  • data-aware insights
  • Premium support
  • access to WPadmin V2 after setup
  • managed technical workspace access
  • managed shell and CLI sessions on supported hosting
  • customer verification and onboarding support for V2
  • 150 monthly questions
  • pricing shown in the client plugin: $10 for the first month, then $30 per month

What V1 Does

V1 is the WordPress assistant built into this plugin. It helps users:

  • understand plugins, themes, and WordPress settings
  • troubleshoot common issues
  • get implementation guidance quickly
  • ask for code snippets and configuration help
  • analyze site data on the Premium plan when data sharing is enabled

What Premium V2 Adds

Premium V2 is for cases where answers alone are not enough.

After your environment is prepared by the WPadmin.AI team and marked ready, V2 can provide:

  • a managed technical workspace launched from WordPress admin
  • deeper troubleshooting on supported hosting environments
  • managed shell and CLI sessions
  • file, environment, and server-side investigation
  • more hands-on technical work than V1 alone can provide

V2 is intentionally gated and requires:

  • an active Premium subscription
  • successful provisioning and compatible hosting
  • the environment to be marked ready
  • customer verification before launch

Use Cases

V1 examples

  • fix a plugin or theme issue
  • get plugin recommendations for a business goal
  • ask how to configure SMTP or permalinks
  • request a code snippet for a common change
  • understand how your WordPress setup works

Premium V2 examples

  • investigate more advanced technical problems
  • work through server-side troubleshooting
  • use managed shell and CLI access from WordPress admin
  • collaborate on deeper technical tasks after onboarding

Compatible with Common WordPress Setups

WPadmin.AI is designed to work with the kinds of plugins and setups WordPress site owners already use, including WooCommerce, Gravity Forms, ACF, Elementor, Yoast SEO, Wordfence, Contact Form 7, UpdraftPlus, and many others.

The assistant adapts its guidance based on your active plugins, theme, and site configuration.

Privacy and Security

  • Data is deleted from WPadmin.AI servers after inactivity windows defined by the service
  • WordPress admin requests use capability checks and nonce validation
  • License and entitlement decisions are handled server-to-server
  • Premium V2 sessions require additional entitlement and verification checks before launch

Privacy Policy: https://members.wpadmin.ai/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://members.wpadmin.ai/terms-of-service

Support

  • Email: hello@wpspins.com
  • Website: https://wpspins.com/
  • Product site: https://wpadmin.ai/

Privacy

This plugin sends prompt text and your site URL to the WPadmin.AI API for response generation and license checks. No personal or sensitive data is shared.

Privacy Policy: https://members.wpadmin.ai/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://members.wpadmin.ai/terms-of-service

External Services

This plugin connects to WPadmin.AI servers to provide AI responses.

  • Data Sent: Prompt text and site URL
  • When: On plugin activation and when prompts are submitted
  • Service: WPadmin.AI (https://members.wpadmin.ai/)
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from your WordPress admin area.
  2. Go to Settings > AI Assistant for the WPadmin.
  3. Choose the Free or Premium plan.
  4. Start asking questions from the dashboard chatbox.

Premium V2 onboarding is currently manual for security reasons. If your hosting is compatible and your Premium subscription is active, the WPadmin.AI team can prepare your environment and notify you when it is ready.
